Intruction toe pivot table



Table Customer


1.Select all the colums in the sheet
2.go to the insert toggle bar aclick on the pivot table 
3.then you can do operations of your own by draggin the the columns header according to the user requirement


Q. Company frequemcy based on country
1.Drag counry to the row
2.drag country to count

Suppose you want to do other operations for that click on the right side of the count can change to other operations accordingly
